en: Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a broad intersection with early 20th‑century cars parked in the foreground and many pedestrians. On the left are several ornate multi‑storey apartment or hotel buildings with turrets and balconies. On the right stands a large, richly decorated neoclassical theater or opera house with columns, statues and arched windows. Tram or trolley tracks run diagonally across the lower part of the image. The overall look suggests a European city center in the interwar period.
